explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/885 (Erdős–Rosenfeld): for every k ≥ 1, are there N_1 < … < N_k with |⋂ D(N_i)| ≥ k? The statement asks for a k-element Finset of positive integers, which is equivalent to distinct ordered N_i, with ncard of the intersection ≥ k; the intersection is finite. D(n) includes 0 for perfect squares, exactly as the page's definition {|a-b| : n = ab} allows. Faithful.
